hints: In right $\triangle OAT$, $AT = r\tan\theta$, so area is $\frac{1}{2}r^2\tan\theta$.
Subtract sector area from triangle area.
walkthrough:
In right-angled triangle $\triangle OAT$ ($AT \perp OA$ with $OA = r$ and $\angle AOB = \theta$):
$$AT = r\tan\theta$$
$$\text{Area}(\triangle OAT) = \frac{1}{2}(OA)(AT) = \frac{1}{2}r(r\tan\theta) = \frac{1}{2}r^2\tan\theta$$

Calculate the area of sector $OAB$:
$$\text{Area}(\text{sector } OAB) = \frac{1}{2}r^2\theta$$

Subtract the sector area from the triangle area:
$$\text{Shaded Area} = \frac{1}{2}r^2\tan\theta - \frac{1}{2}r^2\theta = \frac{1}{2}r^2(\tan\theta - \theta)$$

hints: Calculate $AT = 3\tan(1.2) \approx 7.716\text{ cm}$ and $OT = \frac{3}{\cos(1.2)} \approx 8.279\text{ cm}$, giving $BT = 5.279\text{ cm}$.
walkthrough:
Calculate the circular arc length $AB$ with $r = 3\text{ cm}$ and $\theta = 1.2\text{ radians}$:
$$\text{Arc } AB = r\theta = 3 \times 1.2 = 3.6\text{ cm}$$

Calculate the length of the tangent segment $AT$:
$$AT = r\tan\theta = 3\tan(1.2) \approx 3(2.57215) \approx 7.7165\text{ cm}$$

Calculate the straight segment $BT$ along the secant line $OBT$:
$$OT = \frac{r}{\cos\theta} = \frac{3}{\cos(1.2)} \approx \frac{3}{0.36236} \approx 8.2791\text{ cm}$$
$$BT = OT - r = 8.2791 - 3 = 5.2791\text{ cm}$$

Sum the three boundary lengths to find the total perimeter:
$$\text{Perimeter} = AT + \text{Arc } AB + BT = 7.7165 + 3.6 + 5.2791 = 16.5956 \approx 16.6\text{ cm} \quad (\text{to 3 s.f.})$$
